meta.access_policy: ATTENTION: AGENTS MUST ONLY READ OR OPERATE THIS TEMPLATE THROUGH THE xc-orchestration-author SKILL AND ITS PUBLIC COMMANDS. DO NOT OPEN, SUMMARIZE, EDIT, PATCH, OR REFORMAT THIS FILE DIRECTLY.

node.title: Prepare work order
node.instructions: Read the project bridge, open the work order through xc-open-work-order, validate requested feature IDs without creating features, determine and validate work_order.document_language through xc-document from the explicit parameter or initiating user request, and record the requested scope.
node.deliverables: An authoritative workbench and explicit feature associations.
node.acceptance: The workbench is independent, feature associations are explicit, work_order.document_language is set before any document write, and no unmanaged feature directory was created.

node.title: Approve work order solution
node.instructions: Present the selected change solution, baseline impact, implementation strategy, verification strategy, and unresolved decisions. Record approval or add revision nodes.
node.deliverables: An approval decision or explicit revision work.
node.acceptance: Implementation cannot proceed on a material unresolved solution decision.

node.title: Produce change review report
node.instructions: Produce the change report for this work order after verification and before the result document, because only implemented and verified code has a state worth describing. The report group is mounted by the mode-derived commitment value work_order.requires_report, not by a measurement that does not exist yet. Embed the xc-change-report subtree once under this group, or run a single role=report node that carries the same contract, after publishing report.path, report.manifest_path, report.baseline_commit, report.baseline_digest, report.language, report.strength, report.gate_required, and report.gate_outcome. This group has two legal outcomes and the deliverables follow the outcome: when prepare-manifest measures one or more analyzable units, produce the report; when it measures zero analyzable units, record work_order.report_skip_reason=zero_analyzable_units and produce no report, and a user waiver records work_order.report_skip_reason=user_waived. A skipped gate records report.gate_outcome=not-run, never accepted.
node.deliverables: On the produced outcome: one change-report.html, one change-report-manifest.json, and one change-report-verdicts.json under the workbench report node artifact directory. On the skipped outcome: no report file is required, and the deliverable is the recorded work_order.report_skip_reason with report.run_required=false.
node.acceptance: Exactly one of the two outcomes holds. Either the report exists at report.path and is proven by report.manifest_path, or prepare-manifest measured zero analyzable units or the user waived the step, report.run_required is false, and work_order.report_skip_reason records one of the legal reasons; a produced report is never accepted without its manifest, and a skip is never accepted without its reason.

node.title: Finalize ordinary work order
node.instructions: Confirm the work order result, declared artifacts, feature baseline synchronization, code provenance, and residual risks, then close the work order. Consume work_order.report_skip_reason: when work_order.requires_report is true and neither a report path nor one of the two legal skip reasons is recorded, the work order must not close.
node.deliverables: A completed, failed, or blocked work order with durable evidence.
node.acceptance: The runtime tree and workbench documents accurately describe the work order outcome, and a committed report obligation is either satisfied by a report path or explicitly recorded as a skip decision.
